description: File selected findings from your completed MCP Auto Review or visual comparison in its original project. Preserves saved images, page, captured context and fix guidance without scanning again. Repeating the same job and indexes recovers existing issues; inspect every finding outcome for partial completion. Old jobs without retained page provenance cannot be filed.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

findingIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes in result.findings (Auto Review) or result.diffs (comparison). Only explicitly selected findings are filed.

jobId.description: Completed MCP Auto Review or visual comparison job ID

name: create_review_issues
